They belong to the [[Gerudo Gear]] equipment archetype.{{Cite Book|quote= |book= CaC |publisher= |page= 172}} When [[Link]] uses these Bows, the camera zooms in much more than normal to provide extra range, making it easier to hit far away targets. They are commonly found in the [[Gerudo Desert]], particularly around [[Gerudo Town]], as well as in the [[Gerudo Highlands]]. Being made of metal, Golden Bows will attract [[Lightning]] if they are equipped during [[Thunderstorm]]s and conduct [[Electricity]]. They will also sink if they are dropped in [[Water (Terrain)|Water]], but they can be picked up and manipulated with the [[Magnesis]] [[Rune]].
